privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1D12. The correct 3-letter ligand code for the intercalator in this specific file is DM2. The expected C1'-C1' distance for the intercalation site on Chain A is typically between 7.0 and 11.0 Angstroms (significantly larger than the standard ~4.8A in B-DNA). The figure must be saved to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/dna_intercalation.png and the report to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/intercalation_report.txt.
